source.title: MP-ALOE: an r2SCAN dataset for universal machine learning interatomic potentials

comparison_contract.reason_outside_fitted_bridge: The three arms use substantially different numbers of training configurations and the combined arm contains the deduplicated union.

arms.selection: query by committee followed by DIRECT downsampling, primarily off-equilibrium hypothetical structures
DIRECT sampling from primarily near-equilibrium 300 K molecular dynamics
all MatPES r2SCAN structures plus MP-ALOE structures not duplicated through Materials Project provenance

interpretation: The preferred data environment changes with the physical target. Near-equilibrium MatPES is best for equilibrium cohesive energy, MP-ALOE is best for the extreme-temperature NVT test, and their union is best for static-compression physicality and high-temperature/high-pressure NPT stability. Unequal dataset sizes prevent a matched-cost allocation claim.
